Name:           bpftrace
Version:        0.24.2
Release:        1
Summary:        High-level tracing language for Linux eBPF
License:        Apache-2.0

Source0:        %{name}-%{version}.tar.gz
Source1001:     %{name}.manifest
Source1002:     prebuilt-static-bpftrace.tar.gz
Patch0:         static-link-libbpf.patch

ExclusiveArch:  armv7l aarch64

BuildRequires:  gcc-c++
BuildRequires:  bison
BuildRequires:  flex
BuildRequires:  cmake
BuildRequires:  pkgconfig(libelf)
BuildRequires:  zlib-devel
BuildRequires:  llvm-devel
BuildRequires:  llvm-static-devel
BuildRequires:  clang-devel
BuildRequires:  bcc-tools-devel
BuildRequires:  libbpf-devel
# for xxd command
BuildRequires:  vim
BuildRequires:  cereal-devel
BuildRequires:  tar
BuildRequires:  libomp
%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
BuildRequires:  bcc-tools-static
BuildRequires:  libbpf-static
BuildRequires:  liblzma-static
BuildRequires:  zlib-devel-static
%endif

%description
BPFtrace is a high-level tracing language for Linux enhanced Berkeley Packet
Filter (eBPF) available in recent Linux kernels (4.x). BPFtrace uses LLVM as a
backend to compile scripts to BPF-bytecode and makes use of BCC for
interacting with the Linux BPF system, as well as existing Linux tracing
capabilities: kernel dynamic tracing (kprobes), user-level dynamic tracing
(uprobes), and tracepoints. The BPFtrace language is inspired by awk and C,
and predecessor tracers such as DTrace and SystemTap

%package common
Summary: Common files for bpftrace (scripts, man pages, bash-completion)

%description common
This package contains architecture-independent files for bpftrace:
- Example bpftrace scripts (.bt files)
- Man pages
- Bash completion

%package static
Summary: High-level tracing language for Linux eBPF (static binary)

%description static
BPFtrace is a high-level tracing language for Linux enhanced Berkeley Packet
Filter (eBPF) available in recent Linux kernels (4.x). BPFtrace uses LLVM as a
backend to compile scripts to BPF-bytecode and makes use of BCC for
interacting with the Linux BPF system, as well as existing Linux tracing
capabilities: kernel dynamic tracing (kprobes), user-level dynamic tracing
(uprobes), and tracepoints. The BPFtrace language is inspired by awk and C,
and predecessor tracers such as DTrace and SystemTap

This package is the bpftrace static binary.

%prep
%setup -q
%patch0 -p1
cp %{SOURCE1001} .
tar xzvf %{SOURCE1002}
%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
# Keep a single shared unwinder for glibc pthread cancellation. The C++
# libraries remain static; GCC and undefined-toolchain paths stay unchanged.
test "$(grep -Fc 'target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-static-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")' src/CMakeLists.txt)" = 1
sed -i 's/target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-static-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")/target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-shared-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")/' src/CMakeLists.txt
%endif

%build
%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
bpftrace_original_ldflags="${LDFLAGS}"
export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
%endif

%{?asan:/usr/bin/gcc-unforce-options}
%{?ubsan:/usr/bin/gcc-unforce-options}

mkdir build
cd build
cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DSTATIC_LINKING=OFF \
         -DCMAKE_SKIP_RPATH:BOOL=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH=%{_prefix}
%make_build
cd ..

%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
# Keep the ordinary shared build unchanged; build the static subpackage separately.
# CMake treats this option as source-relative, so preserve that form explicitly.
ln -s "%{_libdir}/libclang.a" build/libclang-static-input.a
libclang_static_relpath=build/libclang-static-input.a
LDFLAGS="${bpftrace_original_ldflags} -stdlib=libc++" \
cmake -S . -B build-static -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
      -DSTATIC_LINKING=ON -DCMAKE_SKIP_RPATH:BOOL=ON \
      -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH=%{_prefix} \
      -DLIBCLANG_STATIC_PATH:STRING="${libclang_static_relpath}" \
      -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="${bpftrace_original_ldflags} -stdlib=libc++" \
      -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES="-Wl,--start-group %{_libdir}/libc++.a %{_libdir}/libc++abi.a -Wl,--end-group"
cmake --build build-static --target bpftrace -- %{?_smp_mflags}
%endif

%install
cd build
%make_install
cd ..

# Install bpftrace static binary
%if %{defined _toolchain}
%if %{toolchain_is clang}
install -m 0755 build-static/src/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
%else
install -m 0755 prebuilt-static-bpftrace/%{_arch}%{_bindir}/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
%endif
%else
install -m 0755 prebuilt-static-bpftrace/%{_arch}%{_bindir}/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
%endif

%post static
cp -rf %{_bindir}/%{name}-static %{_bindir}/%{name}
rm -rf %{_bindir}/%{name}-static

%postun static
rm -rf %{_bindir}/%{name}

%files
%manifest %{name}.manifest
%license LICENSE
%{_bindir}/%{name}
%{_bindir}/%{name}-aotrt

%files common
%manifest %{name}.manifest
%license LICENSE
%{_datadir}/bpftrace/
%{_datadir}/man/man8/*.gz
%{_datadir}/bash-completion/completions/bpftrace

%manifest %{name}.manifest
%license LICENSE
%{_bindir}/%{name}-static

commit 72fda9941031fc35d8825e73446ca43153c4b69b
Author:     He Fangyu <fangyu.he@samsung.com>
AuthorDate: Tue Sep 22 21:05:20 2026 +0800
Commit:     He Fangyu <fangyu.he@samsung.com>
CommitDate: Tue Sep 22 21:05:20 2026 +0800

    Build the static subpackage from source under libc++
    
    When build_with_libcxx is set, build bpftrace-static from the same
    source tree instead of installing the prebuilt Source1002 binary:
    
    - add static BuildRequires (bcc-tools-static, libbpf-static,
      liblzma-static, zlib-devel-static);
    - switch the static link to -shared-libgcc so glibc pthread
      cancellation uses a single unwinder; the C++ runtime stays static;
    - preserve the original LDFLAGS and configure a separate build-static
      tree with STATIC_LINKING=ON and the static libclang archive, keeping
      the ordinary shared build unchanged;
    - install the new static binary when the toolchain is clang, and keep
      the prebuilt Source1002 binary for GCC and undefined-toolchain builds.
    
    Add static-link-libbpf.patch and apply it in prep: the local
    LIBCLANG_STATIC_PATH extension linked -lbpf although libbpf.a was
    available. Use ${LIBBPF_LIBRARIES} so that the static binary depends
    only on glibc and libgcc_s.
    
    Verified: armv7l/aarch64 static DT_NEEDED exactly libm, libgcc_s, libc
    and the loader; armv7l board paired tests 12/12 against the prebuilt
    binary; shared-libgcc cancellation probes 20/20. GCC and
    undefined-toolchain build paths retain their existing behavior.

- switch the static link to -shared-libgcc so glibc pthread
  cancellation uses a single unwinder; the C++ runtime stays static;
- preserve the original LDFLAGS and configure a separate build-static
  tree with STATIC_LINKING=ON and the static libclang archive, keeping
  the ordinary shared build unchanged;
- install the new static binary when the toolchain is clang, and keep
  the prebuilt Source1002 binary for GCC and undefined-toolchain builds.

Add static-link-libbpf.patch and apply it in prep: the local
LIBCLANG_STATIC_PATH extension linked -lbpf although libbpf.a was
available. Use ${LIBBPF_LIBRARIES} so that the static binary depends
only on glibc and libgcc_s.

Verified: armv7l/aarch64 static DT_NEEDED exactly libm, libgcc_s, libc
and the loader; armv7l board paired tests 12/12 against the prebuilt
binary; shared-libgcc cancellation probes 20/20. GCC and
undefined-toolchain build paths retain their existing behavior.

 packaging/bpftrace.spec            | 36 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 packaging/static-link-libbpf.patch | 11 +++++++++
 2 files changed, 47 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 packaging/static-link-libbpf.patch

 Source1001:     %{name}.manifest
 Source1002:     prebuilt-static-bpftrace.tar.gz
+Patch0:         static-link-libbpf.patch
 
 ExclusiveArch:  armv7l aarch64
 
@@ -35,6 +36,10 @@ BuildRequires:  libomp
 %if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
 BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
 BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+BuildRequires:  bcc-tools-static
+BuildRequires:  libbpf-static
+BuildRequires:  liblzma-static
+BuildRequires:  zlib-devel-static
 %endif
 
 %description
@@ -71,11 +76,19 @@ This package is the bpftrace static binary.
 
 %prep
 %setup -q
+%patch0 -p1
 cp %{SOURCE1001} .
 tar xzvf %{SOURCE1002}
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+# Keep a single shared unwinder for glibc pthread cancellation. The C++
+# libraries remain static; GCC and undefined-toolchain paths stay unchanged.
+test "$(grep -Fc 'target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-static-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")' src/CMakeLists.txt)" = 1
+sed -i 's/target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-static-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")/target_link_options(bpftrace BEFORE PRIVATE "-shared-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++")/' src/CMakeLists.txt
+%endif
 
 %build
 %if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+bpftrace_original_ldflags="${LDFLAGS}"
 export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
 export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
 %endif
@@ -90,13 +103,36 @@ cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=
 %make_build
 cd ..
 
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+# Keep the ordinary shared build unchanged; build the static subpackage separately.
+# CMake treats this option as source-relative, so preserve that form explicitly.
+ln -s "%{_libdir}/libclang.a" build/libclang-static-input.a
+libclang_static_relpath=build/libclang-static-input.a
+LDFLAGS="${bpftrace_original_ldflags} -stdlib=libc++" \
+cmake -S . -B build-static -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
+      -DSTATIC_LINKING=ON -DCMAKE_SKIP_RPATH:BOOL=ON \
+      -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH=%{_prefix} \
+      -DLIBCLANG_STATIC_PATH:STRING="${libclang_static_relpath}" \
+      -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="${bpftrace_original_ldflags} -stdlib=libc++" \
+      -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES="-Wl,--start-group %{_libdir}/libc++.a %{_libdir}/libc++abi.a -Wl,--end-group"
+cmake --build build-static --target bpftrace -- %{?_smp_mflags}
+%endif
+
 %install
 cd build
 %make_install
 cd ..
 
 # Install bpftrace static binary
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+install -m 0755 build-static/src/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
+%else
 install -m 0755 prebuilt-static-bpftrace/%{_arch}%{_bindir}/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
+%endif
+%else
+install -m 0755 prebuilt-static-bpftrace/%{_arch}%{_bindir}/bpftrace %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/bpftrace-static
+%endif
 
 %post static
 cp -rf %{_bindir}/%{name}-static %{_bindir}/%{name}
